name: Kingy AI Price Index
citation: Kingy AI Price Index, April 2026 edition. Kingy AI. https://kingy.ai/ai-price-index/2026-04/

edition.label: April 2026
edition.headline: In April 2026, a million AI tokens cost a median $3.75 from frontier models (down 19.5%), $1.41 from mid-range models (up 46.1%) and $0.46 from small models (up 105.6%). A typical AI subscription cost $20.00 a month (no change), and top plans cost $200.00 (no change). Changes compare with March.

story.title: Small-model prices rose 105.6% in April
story.text: The median small model cost $0.46 per million tokens, up from $0.23 in March. Google and Mistral AI launched pricier small models and OpenAI is now counted.
